shared_elements: schematic linear motifs of uncertain reference
multiple separate figures spread over a single surface
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry several separate animal-like figures in profile together with curved or U-shaped linear motifs, something almost any tradition could produce. B shows a tiered, register-like composition of clearly identified creatures (long-necked birds, a snake-like descending form, crouching quadrupeds) beneath a row of arcade-and-block signs, whereas A shows a few sparse, thin outline figures and open arcs with no registers, no interaction between figures and no recognisable repeated sign row.
